## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] No inspector name, email, phone, exact address, or direct contact information is exposed publicly
- [ ] Supabase changes are included as a new file in `supabase/migrations/`
- [ ] Existing migrations were not edited after deployment
- [ ] Main affected pages were tested

## Supabase migration

- [ ] No database change
- [ ] Migration included and ready for the manual migration workflow

## Rollback

Describe the simplest rollback or identify the previous working commit.
